claim: Build steps that run outside the engine (start-state derivation, loading-screen step, recolour, byte transplant) are not reproducible, so move each into the engine's auto build.

evidence.text: The derivation (clean_start) and the screen (loading_nex) now run in auto.
The v1.3 patch was engine output plus v1.0 Enhanced store and screen bank via delta scripts; moved into the engine.
Start state and loading screen were steps outside the engine; to48, has_trainer_prompt and loading_nex now run in auto.
The approved .nex came from a script after the engine (mkload.py); importing it needs the step in the engine.
The approved build had two steps outside the engine, moved from the run folder.
The constant for a build without sets (83) was above the real top (75), so main's default differed.
